nodes.name: Reviews mailbox (IMAP)
nodes.notes: Attach the IMAP credential "Zarin reviews mailbox" (platform level; see n8n/README.md). Marks each mail read after taking it.

meta.notes: F10: the shared reviews mailbox (IMAP, platform level) → POST /v1/reviews/inbound-email (signed). PocketBase resolves the hotel from the address, parses and drops the mail. Generic parser only: every review waits for a person until per-site templates exist.
